name: Pawn Captures Queen

meta.next: Calm Before the Storm (Alliance), Calm Before the Storm (Horde)

summary: Alchemist Pestlezugg sends you into Un'Goro Crater with a lure for the Gorishi Hive Queen. After Bungle in the Jungle, he wants her brain brought to Gadgetzan for study.

sections.title: The Lure and the Crystal
sections.body: Pestlezugg gives you a lure for the silithid hive. He believes a crystal in the hive network attunes the whole swarm, and the hatcheries are the best place to search. Apply the lure to the crystal, and the queen should emerge with several guards beside her.

sections.title: The Queen's Brain
sections.body: Pestlezugg wants you to carry the queen's brain to Gadgetzan. He knows it sounds icky, but says the brain is badly needed for study.

sections.title: After the Queen Falls
sections.body: Pestlezugg suspects a malign intelligence may control the silithid. The thought of what could command something so insidious makes him shudder. When the brain arrives, he calls it quite a victory, yet doubts this is the full extent of the silithid presence. The resolution seems too clean to him.

faq.q: Where is the Gorishi Hive Queen?
faq.answer: Use Pestlezugg's lure on a crystal in the silithid hive in Un'Goro Crater. He expects to find one in the hatcheries, where it should draw out the queen.

faq.q: What is the crystal in the hive for?
faq.answer: Pestlezugg thinks a crystal in the hive network attunes the whole silithid swarm. The lure is meant for that crystal, and the hatcheries are the place to search.

faq.q: Why does Pestlezugg want the queen's brain?
faq.answer: Pestlezugg says the queen's brain is badly needed for study and wants you to bring it to Gadgetzan.

aliases: what quest comes before pawn captures queen
faq.answer: Before this, Pestlezugg asked you for a scent gland and Un'Goro soil to brew the lure in Bungle in the Jungle.
